title: Theo and the Landfall
author: Hazel Sandoval
blurb: Paloma Dunmore, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the dry season ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
